QuestInfo.name: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Oldmaple-Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.0: I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
QuestInfo.1: You run into #bRowen#k again, the fairy who gave you fresh milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts you as Ronnie's friend... Rowen is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells you that Grendel is concerned about the cursed dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take away the #bcursed dolls#k from them... So, you readily accept the request to collect #b50 cursed dolls#k, but fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b50 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you 7 ores. You hope the forest will return to normal...

0.0: You're #p1061004#'s friend. You came just at the right time. It's not easy for me to ask a human for help, but... I have a hunch that I can trust you on this.
0.1: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm #p1032101#, secretary of the Head Magician in this town, #b#p1032001##k. We've been looking for a traveler who can help us out. Well, would you like to hear the whole story?
0.2: #p1032001# used to be very much into #bblack magic#k, which was considered off limits. Black magic is VERY powerful, but there's a chance it can backfire and the Magician casting the magic might lose the ability to use magic altogether. So it's very potent but requires utmost caution.
0.3: #p1032001# wasn't fully trained, but he thought he could handle it. He tried to bring a straw doll to life. Anyone with half a brain knows that magic that has to do with life itself is absolutely forbidden!
0.4: Something went terribly wrong in the process and the curse of black magic seeped into the doll, transforming it into a #r#t4000031##k that had to be sealed up forever. In the end, #p1032001# sealed the #t4000031# up and placed it somewhere unknown.
0.5: But then the #o3210800#s that live around #m101000000# forest took the doll. When they returned to the forest, they became zombies. The #bZombie #o3210800#s#k are now wreaking havoc in the forest. #p1032001# assigned me to handle the situation, but he couldn't really expect me to resolve the whole thing alone.
0.6: To get the forest back to the way it used to be, we need to kill the Zombie #o3210800#s and remove the #b#t4000031#s#k. I'm awfully busy here, so will you do this in my place?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o4230101#s are often seen in the Dark Tree Forest near #m101000000#. Just bring me #b50#k #b#t4000031#s#k.

no.0: I see... I thought you were the right person to ask, but I guess I was wrong... I understand that you're busy, but if you ever have a change of heart, please find me.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me 50 #t4000031#s! That means you've thinned out the #o4230101#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you save me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I've also gotten you some ores from the forest. Please put them to good use. So long!

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect 50 #b#t4000031#s#k yet. The #t4000031# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
